# Hatch Pet (vendored helpers)

GenPet ships only the deterministic image helpers from OpenAI's Hatch Pet skill (Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)). The upstream workflow text, its sequential/cardinal/blind-review scripts and QA references were removed; read the original skill for historical runs.

Use [GENPET.md](GENPET.md) and the plugin's `references/desktop.md` for every run. Do not apply the upstream literal action/gaze requirements, effect bans or reviewer templates as GenPet artistic gates.
